Pronunciation Key for Orin

Welcome to the Orin language. Speak clearly and confidently.

The word sela means welcome. It is pronounced SEH-lah.

To perform sela correctly: stress the first syllable, and keep both vowels clear.

Remember: stress the first syllable.

Practice this pronunciation until it feels natural. Use SEH-lah as your guide.

sela is pronounced SEH-lah. Always stress the first syllable.

You are now ready to speak Orin with clarity and precision.
